title: On certain audio setups, "No input or output devices found" placeholder appears briefly after connecting/disconnecting audio device
line: The Audio Volume popup no longer flashes "No output or input devices found" when a device is plugged or unplugged.
explanation: On some sound cards a jack plug makes the audio server drop and re-add every device. The applet showed its "No output or input devices found" placeholder the moment both device lists were empty, so it flashed for a fraction of a second on every plug or unplug. The placeholder now waits 500 ms and only appears if the view is still empty, so a short refresh shows an empty list instead of the message.

commits.message:
applet: debounce the "no devices" placeholder

When an audio device is plugged or unplugged, some setups briefly drop
all devices, so the popup flashed the "No output or input devices
found" message. Only show the placeholder once the view stays empty.

BUG: 509749

patches.diff:
From e16d48b4dbb07d30bc4dacc047e8251af93a204a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 02:25:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applet: debounce the "no devices" placeholder

When an audio device is plugged or unplugged, some setups briefly drop
all devices, so the popup flashed the "No output or input devices
found" message. Only show the placeholder once the view stays empty.

BUG: 509749
---
 applet/main.qml | 14 +++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 13 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applet/main.qml b/applet/main.qml
index 1e44cded..ec96c84b 100644
--- a/applet/main.qml
+++ b/applet/main.qml
@@ -564,17 +564,29 @@ PlasmoidItem {
             }
 
             Loader {
+                readonly property bool empty: scrollView.placeholderText.length > 0 && !upperSection.visible && !lowerSection.visible
+
                 parent: scrollView
                 anchors.centerIn: parent
                 width: parent.width -  Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 4
                 active: visible
-                visible: scrollView.placeholderText.length > 0 && !upperSection.visible && !lowerSection.visible
+                visible: empty && !placeholderDelay.running
+                onEmptyChanged: {
+                    if (empty) {
+                        placeholderDelay.restart()
+                    }
+                }
                 sourceComponent: PlasmaExtras.PlaceholderMessage {
                     iconName: scrollView.iconName
                     text: scrollView.placeholderText
                     explanation: scrollView.explanationText
                     helpfulAction: scrollView.helpfulAction
                 }
+
+                Timer {
+                    id: placeholderDelay
+                    interval: 500
+                }
             }
             contentItem: Flickable {
                 contentHeight: layout.implicitHeight
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: during the device refresh the popup shows "No output or input devices found"
Fixed: same moment of the refresh, the list is briefly empty and no message appears
Master: three unplug/replug cycles (sink removed for 0.2 s), the message flashes each time
Fixed: same three cycles, no message

review.text: Simple, clean fix at the right layer for audio setups where PipeWire/ALSA briefly tears down and recreates all devices on jack plug/unplug, matching the maintainer's suggested debounce approach. Using a fixed 500 ms timer avoids breaking when animations are disabled, and the before/after screenshots and videos clearly demonstrate that the transient placeholder flash is gone while genuine disconnection and empty Applications tab placeholders still appear properly.

reviews.text: Simple, clean fix at the right layer for audio setups where PipeWire/ALSA briefly tears down and recreates all devices on jack plug/unplug, matching the maintainer's suggested debounce approach. Using a fixed 500 ms timer avoids breaking when animations are disabled, and the before/after screenshots and videos clearly demonstrate that the transient placeholder flash is gone while genuine disconnection and empty Applications tab placeholders still appear properly.

This is the debounce Nate proposed in c3: the placeholder Loader now only becomes visible after the view has stayed empty for 500 ms, restarting the timer on each empty transition, which is a small, self-contained QML change with no lifetime or binding-loop hazards. The before/after videos (three 0.2 s sink unload/reload cycles) clearly show the message flashing on master and never on the fix, and the regression checks cover the 'Sound Service Lost' state and the Applications tab. The trade-off (a genuinely empty state appearing 0.5 s later while the popup is open) is honestly noted and acceptable.
